inputs: assembled plan body without the digest field
purpose: Order schedule and observation intent by explicit simulation time, tick or declared order, and compute the canonical semantic plan identity from declared content only, excluding run identifiers and wall-clock observations.
state: Stateless canonicalization; the volatile run envelope is the only per-call value.
